title: Only response filters self-authorize a route; ownership grants never do
answers: route reachable without authorization because it has an ownership grant
which after-request handlers count as authorization in basic-auth
body:
Invariant: a route is authorized by a before-request validator, or by a response filter listed in _SELF_AUTHORIZING_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS (filter_* and redact_* functions). set_can_manage_* after-request grants only record ownership after a write and must not exempt the route.
Enforced at mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_authorized_outside_before_request, which checks membership in _SELF_AUTHORIZING_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS for both AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS and WORKSPACE_PARAMETERIZED_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS.
Coverage test: tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py:test_every_ownership_grant_route_has_a_before_request_validator fails when a route with a set_can_manage_* grant has no validator.
Breaks if skipped: a write route that only grants MANAGE afterward runs with no check, and the grant hides the gap from the backstop.
Applies: Any new route with an after-request ownership grant, and any new response filter (it must be added to the frozenset or its route fails closed).
applies: Auth fail-closed logic in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py for every route with an AFTER_REQUEST_PATH_HANDLERS entry.
says: Unauthorized users can submit write requests if ownership is assigned after saving
API endpoints with permission grant actions bypass initial access control verification
New data filtering endpoints are blocked by access denied errors unexpectedly
Ensure write operations require upfront permission checks rather than relying on ownership assignments
search: In mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py, routes must be authorized by a before-request validator or by a response filter registered in _SELF_AUTHORIZING_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS. Enforced in _authorized_outside_before_request for AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS and WORKSPACE_PARAMETERIZED_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS, with test coverage in tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py. After-request ownership grants (set_can_manage_*) only record ownership post-write and must never exempt routes from authorization; unvalidated write routes fail the backstop, and unregistered filter_* or redact_* handlers fail closed.
